en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Hammad Bin Usman, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘A man bequeathed thirty Dinars for the children of Syeda Fatima<sup>asws</sup>. So the man brought it to Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>. So Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Hand it over to so and so old man from the children of Fatima<sup>asws</sup>’, and he was a breadwinner, with scarcity.

So the man said to him<sup>asws</sup>, ‘But rather the man bequeathed with it for the children of Fatima<sup>asws</sup> (to you<sup>asws</sup>)’ So Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘But rather it does not fall upon the (particular) children of Fatima<sup>asws</sup>, and it falls upon this man (who is among the descendants of Syeda<sup>asws</sup>), and for him are dependants’.
en.sarwar: 2. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from Hammad ibn ‘Uthaman who has narrated the following: “A man made a will about thirty dinars for the children of Fatimah, ‘Alayha al-Salam. Another man brought it to abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, who told him to give it to so and so old man of the descendents of Fatimah, ‘Alayha al-Salam, who has a family to feed and is poor.
The man said, ‘The man has a will for the children of Fatimah.’
Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, said, ‘It will not be appropriate by giving to the children of Fatimah, ‘Alayha al-Salam. It will be appropriate to give it to this man who has a family to feed.’”
